description: Minimum trusted Engineering Loop — deterministic gates for this repo. Docs win over agent prose. Blocking = exit 0 required. Advisory = feedback only.

blockingDocs.notes: Must NOT rewrite the report before checking. Regenerate locally with --write and commit.
No-ops until a slice has evidence/*-run.json.

sliceClose.notes: Required when review findings exist; optional empty skip via absent file until first finding.

advisory.notes: Advisory only — must not block merge.

foundationPlus.command: ./gradlew checkstyleMain checkstyleTest spotbugsMain dependencyCheckAnalyze test jacocoTestCoverageVerification build
foundationPlus.notes: Enable commented job in .github/workflows/ci.yml in same commit as Gradle wrapper (foundation-slice DoD).

foundationPlus.command: cd frontend && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
foundationPlus.notes: Enable commented frontend-verify job when frontend tree lands.

humanGates.command: GitHub branch protection: ≥1 approving review from non-author (NFR §7.1)
humanGates.notes: See docs/qa/branch-protection.md. CODEOWNERS is repo hint; protection is org setting.

ciEvidence.notes: CI uploads these when present. Red/green JSON must be produced by recorded commands; validators check shape + ordering, not cryptographic provenance. Prefer CI-generated artifacts once backend-verify exists.

openspecApply.rule: Never mark an OpenSpec task [x] until focused verification for that task has been run and recorded in the session output.
perTaskMinimum: Relevant unit/integration/ArchUnit/doc check for the task surface
Paste decisive exit line into the PR Verification evidence section or evidence notes
